name: YaxUp – Chat Room to Your Website
author: fared

sections.description:
YaxUp – Chat Room to Your Website.

YaxUp Chat adds a simple floating “Open Chat” button to your WordPress website.

Create a Chat Room to Your Website lets you add your YaxUp chat room to WordPress with a simple floating chat button.

Enter your YaxUp room name, choose the button position, and choose where it should appear. If no room name is entered, the button is not shown.

Features:

  • Enter a YaxUp room name or yaxup.com room URL.
  • Position the floating button on the right or left.
  • Show the button on all pages, the homepage only, or posts only.
  • Open the room in a new tab or the same tab.
  • No database tables.
  • No tracking or analytics.
  • No jQuery dependency.
  • Lightweight CSS and JavaScript.

Getting a YaxUp room

To use the plugin, you need a YaxUp chat room.

  1. Visit https://yaxup.com/
  2. Click Create Your Room.
  3. If you are not registered, click Create an Account and register.
  4. Already registered? Login to access your account and get your room name.
  5. Enter the room name in Settings > YaxUp Chat.

External service

This plugin connects your website visitors to the YaxUp service at https://yaxup.com/ when they click the floating chat button. The plugin itself does not load remote JavaScript or send visitor data to YaxUp before the visitor clicks the button.

YaxUp service information:
* Website: https://yaxup.com/
* Privacy Policy: https://yaxup.com/privacy-policy/
* Terms of Service: https://yaxup.com/terms-of-service/

Source Code

This plugin does not use a build process, minification tools, npm, webpack, or other compiled assets.
All PHP, JavaScript, and CSS source code included in the plugin is provided in human-readable form.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the yaxup-chat-room-to-your-website folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate YaxUp - Chat Room to Your Website.
  3. Go to Settings > YaxUp Chat.
  4. Enter your room name and choose your display settings.
  5. Click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
What happens if I leave the room name empty?

The floating chat button is not displayed.

Do I need a YaxUp account?

You need a YaxUp room. Visit https://yaxup.com/ to create an account and room, or login if you already have an account.

Does the plugin use an iframe?

No. The floating button opens your room on YaxUp.

Does the plugin track visitors?

No. This plugin includes no analytics or tracking code.
